title: Now card: tabs as real pages, not hash links

message.text: Taken: each tab gets its own real address, like /now/usage/, instead of #tab=. The same builder does it right after the chat sidebar, so the two changes don't collide in one file.

Got it: no folder per tab. Each tab becomes a page with its own address, like /now/usage/, served by the site's normal page routing. The builder has the change and does it right after the chat sidebar.
